rows.text: It's been a while, Emanator who I'm about to {RUBY_B#peer at}glance at{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: I'm here to deliver some good news, meow.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Congratulations! You've earned the approval of me and the little ones to become the Emanator of the meow-velous Path of Trailblaze!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Yay! I'm an Emanator now, meow!
How moving. You've even adopted my speech patterns, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Time to check out my reward, eh?
No problem! You've earned it, fair and square!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: It really wasn't easy to get a chance to see you.
Meow? This is not just some ordinary meeting. You're in the presence of an Aeon, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: You, your companions, and this Express that travels across the cosmos... Just as I thought, this truly is the shelter that can offer them snacks and warmth.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: I'm more than grateful, meow! So I put a ton of thought into this gift for you, meow~
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Akivimeow uses its round paws and pulls out an exquisitely crafted cat tree.
But around the edges, you can still clearly see the marks of handcrafted workmanship...
Did you... make this yourself?
O-of course not!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Aeons can conjure things with just a thought, meow! No manual labor required!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: It's a brand new cat tree!
Y—You don't like it?
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: The little guys are always running around and bouncing all over the place... I bet they make a total mess when they get too excited, right?
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: So, I made this gift, hoping they'll behave themselves and stay put on it. This way, it'll make your place look way better!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Meow~ Compared to saving the entire world, you probably don't realize what you're doing right now is all that amazing!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: But from what the little ones and I see, you're the coolest person ever, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: I'm so jealous... I mean, these little ones are so lucky to follow me down the meow-velous path of Trailblaze!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow
